name: textlint-rule-ukraine
description: textlint rule that flags inappropriate transliterations of Ukrainian place/person names and auto-fixes them

scripts.test: npm run build && tsc --project tsconfig.test.json && node --test 'test-dist/**/*.test.js'
scripts.release:patch: npm version patch && git push --follow-tags && npm publish
scripts.release:minor: npm version minor && git push --follow-tags && npm publish
scripts.release:major: npm version major && git push --follow-tags && npm publish
